svg.font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Source Sans 3', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Three panels. Panel I: a sphere; two amber arcs leave the north pole N: turning about Y and then X lands at +X, turning about X and then Y lands at −Y, and a dashed arc between the two ends is marked 90°. Panel II: on the left a sphere covered with small cyan arrows, all pointing towards the north pole and shorter near the poles, with a violet ring marking the zero at each pole; on the right a small dashed circle stands for the rotor sphere S³, with a pair of violet frame arrows at every point. Panel III: a 3 × 3 table with rows and columns ψ₀, ψ₁, ψ₂; the diagonal is 1 and the other cells are the cyan inner products 1/√2, (1+i)/2, (1−i)/2; a green tag below reads “LEAN ✓ B∗B = A∗A ⇒ B = UA”.
